description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

Configures legacy or FSLogix advanced redirection. The default is '2' which is the same as "Not Configured".

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\RedirectType
Type:  DWORD
Values:  Legacy = 1, FSLogix Redirection = 2
